notes.summary: The page turns to the subdivision order and contrasts it with the other order. It states the absence of extremal elements and discusses suprema and occasional infima, with an uncertain qualifier after figures. It gives a common-subdivision condition under a worked adjective, defines a moderate contrée by comparability of subdivisions, and says the author knows no particular properties of the subdivision order alone. C5 then states invariance of disjointness under subdivision, with an NB reducing the condition to point-like members using C3. These are manuscript statements, not mathematical results proved in this run.
math_reading_decisions: The two different order relations prompted comparison of their actual strokes: the bowed subdivision sign is distinct from the straight sign after avec. Equivalent preceq/preccurlyeq macro choices were not counted as different readings.
The prose’s second F has three primes while the diagram’s lower node has two. The mismatch is retained; it was not repaired to an expected two-subdivision pair.

The only right-hand F is almost level with upper F prime; the lower-right sign ends in blank space beneath it. The diagram is not regularized into a centered diamond or completed by an inferred endpoint.
The expected supremum wording did not settle toujours versus en général/en position. Toujours is first from the descending loop and following run, with the alternatives retained.
The parenthetical rejection of the term compatibles did not settle the overwritten adjective. Shared comp/bles letters and joint middle-layer alternatives preserve the actual correction.
The NB’s surviving G is read from its rounded outer return and spur. The older F-like layer and X/x case remain uncertain; plain M is retained.
The lower instruction refers to C7 with a distinct lowered oval zero. No later axiom or external context was used to infer that suffix.
author_checks: The upper oblique note says On sera amené à renforcer encore cette condition sur les contrées modérées ! This signals a planned strengthening, not a verification performed here.
Je ne saurais donner aucune propriété particulière de the bowed relation, followed by struck tout and live seul, is preserved with the cancelled C5 at its physical position.
The lower instruction begins Reporter/reporter and asks to move the disjunction axioms after C6 and C7 subscript 0. Its initial case remains uncertain.
The NB says Il suffit de le poser ... à cause de C3. This is the author’s reduction; C3 was not independently proved or reapplied as a check.
The cancelled on a and C5 account for H’s two lower struck placeholders. A preliminary phantom-word interpretation was rejected after crop-based placement comparison.

workflow_note: Three fresh independent readers used v06, each viewing whole and both halves once, then their own 12/16/14 crops. Root compared all three complete returns and viewed 20 existing crops: all12 R1; R2 c02,c03,c04,c11,c13; R3 04,05,10. No new crop was needed. An initial two-image root display was truncated and not counted; the same two files were successfully shown singly. R1 disclosed that crop07 clipped the extreme p descender of comparables; root used the already-existing complete R2 c11 crop. A text-only audit checked exact quotations, nine H ill placeholders and counting scopes. Root adopted the on a/C5 placeholder alignment supported by R1/R3 and the physical crop, dropping the preliminary phantom-placeholder claim. Graphic rows count only their named strokes/layout, not accompanying text already collated. All flags are booleans; equivalent sign macros are excluded from H totals. No OCR, external research, compilation or mathematical validation occurred.
